description: Weekly (Monday 00-09, Berlin), two PRs: one with every minor, patch, pin and digest update, one with every major.
Both merge themselves once CI is green. TypeScript stays below 6 and @types/node below 25 on purpose.
Lock file maintenance stays a PR of its own (Renovate cannot group it with other updates); security fixes come immediately.
Renovate merges by itself (platformAutomerge off); the default branch must require the build-and-test check and nothing else that Renovate cannot satisfy.

packageRules.description: Everything that is not a major in one PR: all package files (root, design/, e2e/) and the workflows. Overrides the monorepo groups of config:recommended.
All majors in one PR. Renovate prefixes the slug with major-, so the branch is renovate/major-all.
@hey-api/openapi-ts loads the TypeScript compiler API and breaks on TypeScript 6. Lift this once a release of openapi-ts supports it.
The engines field pins Node 24; the types follow the runtime, not the other way round.
